metadata.description: HCG harness marketplace — two plugins: hcg-core (default, unhobbled methodology + Task-axis parallelism + 3 workflows) and hcg-harness (legacy pipeline harness — 0.3.0 = hcg-core 이행 램프).

plugins.name: hcg-harness
plugins.description: HCG portable multi-agent development harness (0.3.0 = hcg-core 이행 램프, 신규 설치 권장 안 함): 5 agent shells + 9 portable skills (pipeline-phase / codex-review / verification-ladder / contract-authoring / qa-e2e + db/backend/frontend HCG-stack conventions + ui-standard) + 2 hooks (SessionStart context + migration notice; PreToolUse destructive-command guard only, matcher Bash|PowerShell) + 5 workflow templates (audit / migrate / test-gen / review / converge) + 3 commands (init · upgrade = hcg-core 로의 이행 램프 · qa, invoked /hcg-harness:init · :upgrade · :qa) backed by the scripts/bootstrap.mjs engine + the hcg stack profile + HARNESS core.

plugins.name: hcg-core
plugins.description: HCG unhobbled core (기본 권장): 슬림 방법론(Operating Rules §0–§5 + 작업 라우팅) + Task-축 병렬화(task-agent 1종 · parallel-tasks 스킬) + contracts 문서 규약 + HCG 스택 컨벤션 + codex-review 온디맨드 스킬(닫힌 트리거·백그라운드·게이트 아님) + 워크플로 3종(migrate · test-gen · converge) + SessionStart 훅 1종 + /hcg-core:init · :upgrade. hcg-harness 는 0.3.0 부터 이행 전용이다 — 신규 프로젝트는 hcg-core 를 쓰고, 두 플러그인을 한 프로젝트에 함께 설치하지 않는다.
